transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the Friday support-services review. We've got three separate waste streams coming out of the support area next week — the clinic, the administrative offices, and the motor pool each generate their own. I need to confirm waste classifications, pickup arrangements, and any facility updates before I approve the final waste-handling board. Who wants to walk us through what we're looking at for each stream?

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. I can speak to the clinic waste stream. The clinic's discarded treatment materials are classified as regulated medical waste. However, I need to note that I received a confirmation this morning regarding the contractor pickup, and I'll need to get that added to the board before you approve it. Let me share the specific arrangement details now.

transcript.text: Sir, I can speak to the administrative offices waste stream. The accumulated records are scheduled for secure destruction by the approved shred vendor on Wednesday at 1400.
